question: A line \(a\) is parallel to a plane \(\alpha\). A distinct plane \(\beta\) contains \(a\) and intersects \(\alpha\). How many lines form the intersection of \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\)?
solution: Two intersecting planes produce one line of intersection.
